Uninstall command: C:\Program Files (x86)\Mozilla Firefox\uninstall\helper.exe /S INSTALLATION OF NEW VERSION: Preparing for the Installation Set the variable to disable the crash reporter SET MOZ_CRASHREPORTER_DISABLE = 1 Install the MSI “Firefox Setup 140.10.1esr_en-us.msi” with the transform file “Firefox Setup 140.10.1esr_en-us.mst” Example: msiexec /i "C:\SW-Source\Firefox Setup 140.10.1esr_en-us.msi" TRANSFORMS="C:\SW-Source\Firefox Setup 140.10.1esr_en-us.mst" [IMAGE 1] After installation, the following folders and files are to be copied, as well as the registry keys has to be edit (files are located in the “Files” folder of the provided handover): The folder “License-Info” copy to è C:\Program Files (x86)\Mozilla Firefox The folder “distribution” copy to è C:\Program Files (x86)\Mozilla Firefox The folder “defaults” copy to è C:\Program Files (x86)\Mozilla Firefox [IMAGE 2] The folder “Startpages” copy to è C:\ProgramData\Mozilla (Info: In my evaluation this folder had to be created first) [IMAGE 3] If exists, remove the registry key: è “HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Mozilla\Firefox\Extensions” Create the registry key and value è “HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Wow6432Node\Mozilla\Firefox\Crash Reporter” SubmitCrashReport = 0 Language configuration: If the Windows UI of the user is not german: Delete the file C:\Program Files (x86)\Mozilla Firefox\defaults\pref\local-setting.js If the Windows UI of the user is german -> Do nothing Be aware that the ...
